# Architecture & Component Catalog

Covers PatternFly 6's architecture, design token system, component inventory,
and changes from PatternFly 5. See [citations.md](../citations.md) for source details.

## Design Token Architecture

PatternFly 6 introduced a three-layer design token system [1]:

| Layer | Purpose | Naming |
|-------|---------|--------|
| Palette | Color foundation referenced by other layers | Numerical |
| Base | Conceptual application of palette colors + spacing/borders | Numerical, no duplicates |
| Semantic | User-facing tokens grouped by meaning | Semantic names |

Token naming convention [1]:
`--pf-t--[scope]--[component]--[property]--[concept]--[variant]--[state]`

Not all segments are required; irrelevant segments are omitted [1].

### React Token Format

Tokens are exposed as JavaScript objects with three properties [8]:

```javascript
const t_global_spacer_sm = {
  "name": "--pf-t--global--spacer--sm",
  "value": "0.5rem",
  "var": "var(--pf-t--global--spacer--sm)"
}
```

Import paths: direct ESM (`@patternfly/react-tokens/dist/esm/t_token_name`) or
package-level (`@patternfly/react-tokens`) [8].

### Color System

Nine color families: Gray, Blue (brand), Green (success), Teal, Purple (info),
Yellow (warning), Orange, Red, Red-Orange (danger/critical) [15]. Each hex value
maps to semantic tokens applied across brand, background, text/icon, status, and
non-status categories [15].

## Component Catalog

PatternFly 6.4.0 contains **92 components** [2], including 2 deprecated:

- **Deprecated:** Chip (use Label), Tile (use Card) [2][3]
- **Renamed:** Text → Content [3][16]
- **Promoted from beta in PF6:** Buttons with count label, editable labels,
  flyout/drilldown menus, menu toggle with status, modal title with status,
  inline spinners, timestamp [17]

Notable enterprise-specific components: Login Page, Masthead, Code Editor,
Dual List Selector, Notification Drawer, Progress Stepper, Wizard [2].

### Extensions

- **PatternFly AI Chatbot** (`@patternfly/chatbot@6.4.0`): 7 sub-components
  (Container, Toggle, Header, Footer, Messages, Attachments, Conversation
  History) [33][4]
- **Charts:** Victory-based (moved to `@patternfly/react-charts/victory` [3])
  plus Apache ECharts integration added in 6.2 [4]
- **Data View:** resizable table columns added in 6.4.0 [4]

### Animation System

Micro animations added incrementally [4][9]:
- 6.2: alerts, navigation, notification badges
- 6.3: accordions, expandable sections, navigation expansion
- 6.4.0: simplified animation control via application-level context providers

Three documented motion patterns: button ripple, error jiggle, expansion
fade-and-slide. All respect `prefers-reduced-motion` [9].

## PF5 → PF6 Breaking Changes

### CSS Variable Renaming

All CSS variables renamed [3]:
- PF5: `--pf-v5-global--FontSize--lg`
- PF6: `--pf-t--global--font--size--lg`

### Breakpoint Changes (px → rem)

| Breakpoint | Previous (px) | New (rem) |
|-----------|---------------|-----------|
| sm | 576px | 36rem |
| md | 768px | 48rem |
| lg | 992px | 62rem |
| xl | 1200px | 75rem |
| 2xl | 1450px | 90.625rem |

Source: [3]

### Migration Tooling

66 ESLint-based codemods (30 added after alpha) [17]:
- `class-name-updater` — pf-v5 → pf-v6 prefixes [3]
- `tokens-update` — React tokens + global CSS vars; marks undefined with hot pink [3]
- `css-vars-updater` — non-React files (.css, .scss, .md) [3]

Run via: `npx @patternfly/pf-codemods@latest <path> --v6 --fix` [3]

| Milestone | Date |
|-----------|------|
| PF6 Beta | August 22, 2024 [17] |

| PF 6.2 | April 2025 [4] |
| PF 6.3 | July 2025 [4] |

PF6 was described as the "first major visual update in 4 years" [16].

## Package Structure

Main packages [18]:
- `@patternfly/react-core` (components)
- `@patternfly/react-icons` (icons)
- `@patternfly/react-styles` (CSS-in-JS utilities)
- `@patternfly/react-tokens` (design tokens as JS objects)
- `@patternfly/react-charts` (charting)
- `@patternfly/chatbot` (AI chatbot extension)

Peer dependencies: React ^17 || ^18 || ^19, React-DOM ^17 || ^18 || ^19 [18].
